faq_heading: Homes near Lord Tweedsmuir Secondary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Lord Tweedsmuir Secondary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Lord Tweedsmuir Secondary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Lord Tweedsmuir Secondary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near Lord Tweedsmuir Secondary sell for?
faq.a: Within 2 km of the school, 291 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,244,500, townhomes $745,000, condos $410,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Lord Tweedsmuir Secondary?
faq.a: Within 2 km of Lord Tweedsmuir Secondary the median was 18 days on the market, closing at 96.9% of the list price, with 7% of sales above the list price for the 291 homes within 2 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Lord Tweedsmuir Secondary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Don Christian Elementary (0.9 km east), Martha Currie Elementary (1.1 km south-east) and Cloverdale Catholic School (1.1 km south-west).

Lord Tweedsmuir Secondary is a secondary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 6151 180 St. It teaches grades 8 to 12.
Below are the homes currently for sale whose listing mentions Lord Tweedsmuir Secondary, followed by what homes within 2 km of the school sold for.
How the Lord Tweedsmuir Secondary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Lord Tweedsmuir Secondary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 2 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 2 km of Lord Tweedsmuir Secondary sold for

Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 291 homes sold within 2 km of Lord Tweedsmuir Secondary: 174 houses, 79 townhomes and 29 condos. The largest group was houses, at a median of $1,244,500.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Lord Tweedsmuir Secondary

19 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Lord Tweedsmuir Secondary in a straight line (13 elementary, 4 secondary, 2 other; 3 independent). The closest is Don Christian Elementary, 0.9 km away, and the farthest on this list is Regent Road Elementary, 2.9 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Cloverdale Learning Centre (1.3 km); the nearest independent school is Cloverdale Catholic School (1.1 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Martha Currie Elementary (1.1 km). Other secondary schools close by: Cloverdale Learning Centre (1.3 km south-west), SD 36 Alternate Cloverdale LC (1.3 km south-west), Clayton Heights Secondary (2.3 km north-east), Ecole Salish Secondary (2.5 km north). The nearest school teaching the same grades (8-12) is Clayton Heights Secondary, 2.3 km north-east of Lord Tweedsmuir Secondary.
